pull_request.title: Added a parse_cache_control helper function to httpx/_utils.py to parse

summary: Added a parse_cache_control helper function to httpx/_utils.py to parse Cache-Control headers into a dictionary, including proper handling for quoted strings and malformed directives. Subsequently updated the implementation to use the logging module for warnings instead of print(), and adjusted unit tests to verify logs using the caplog fixture.

+_CACHE_CONTROL_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"^[!#$%&'*+\-.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z]+$")
+_CACHE_CONTROL_QUOTED_RE = re.compile(r'^"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"$')
+
+
+def _split_cache_control_directives(header: str) -> list[str]:
+    directives: list[str] = []
+    current: list[str] = []
+    in_quotes = False
+    escaped = False
+
+    for char in header:
+        if escaped:
+            current.append(char)
+            escaped = False
+        elif char == "\\" and in_quotes:
+            current.append(char)
+            escaped = True
+        elif char == '"':
+            in_quotes = not in_quotes
+            current.append(char)
+        elif char == "," and not in_quotes:
+            directives.append("".join(current))
+            current = []
+        else:
+            current.append(char)
+
+    directives.append("".join(current))
+    return directives
+
+
+def parse_cache_control(header: str) -> dict[str, str | bool]:
+    """
+    Parse an HTTP Cache-Control header into a dict of lowercase directives.
+
+    Valueless flags map to True and key=value directives map to their string value.
+    """
+    directives: dict[str, str | bool] = {}
+
+    for raw_directive in _split_cache_control_directives(header):
+        directive = raw_directive.strip()
+        if not directive:
+            continue
+
+        if "=" not in directive:
+            if not _CACHE_CONTROL_TOKEN_RE.match(directive):
+                logger.warning("Malformed Cache-Control directive: %r", directive)
+                continue
+            directives[directive.lower()] = True
+            continue
+
+        key, value = directive.split("=", 1)
+        if not _CACHE_CONTROL_TOKEN_RE.match(key):
+            logger.warning("Malformed Cache-Control directive: %r", directive)
+            continue
+
+        if _CACHE_CONTROL_QUOTED_RE.match(value):
+            directives[key.lower()] = re.sub(r"\\(.)", r"\1", value[1:-1])
+        elif _CACHE_CONTROL_TOKEN_RE.match(value):
+            directives[key.lower()] = value
+        else:
+            logger.warning("Malformed Cache-Control directive: %r", directive)
+
+    return directives

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ["header", "expected"],
+    [
+        ("", {}),
+        ("   ", {}),
+        ("no-cache", {"no-cache": True}),
+        ("No-Cache, NO-STORE", {"no-cache": True, "no-store": True}),
+        (
+            "public, max-age=3600, must-revalidate",
+            {"public": True, "max-age": "3600", "must-revalidate": True},
+        ),
+        (
+            "MAX-AGE=60, s-maxage=120",
+            {"max-age": "60", "s-maxage": "120"},
+        ),
+        (
+            'no-cache="Set-Cookie, Authorization", max-age="300"',
+            {"no-cache": "Set-Cookie, Authorization", "max-age": "300"},
+        ),
+        (
+            r'ext="foo\"bar\\baz", empty=""',
+            {"ext": 'foo"bar\\baz', "empty": ""},
+        ),
+        (
+            "public, , max-age=60,",
+            {"public": True, "max-age": "60"},
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_parse_cache_control(header, expected, caplog):
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="httpx._utils"):
+        assert parse_cache_control(header) == expected
+    assert caplog.records == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ["header", "expected"],
+    [
+        ("=3600", {}),
+        ("max-age=", {}),
+        ("no cache", {}),
+        ("max-age=10 20", {}),
+        ("max-age=1=2", {}),
+        ('no-cache="unterminated', {}),
+        ('no-cache="foo"bar', {}),
+        ('no-cache="escaped\\"', {}),
+        ("public, =bad, max-age=, no-store", {"public": True, "no-store": True}),
+    ],
+)
+def test_parse_cache_control_malformed(header, expected, caplog):
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="httpx._utils"):
+        assert parse_cache_control(header) == expected
+    assert caplog.records
+    assert all(
+        record.name == "httpx._utils" and record.levelno == logging.WARNING
+        for record in caplog.records
+    )
+    assert "Malformed Cache-Control directive" in caplog.text
